normalization_rules: Preserve hierarchy so section/rule context is never lost.
Store source locator and retrieval date for every substantive record.
Do not infer legal effect from a title alone.
Do not mark a record verified merely because it was imported automatically.
Never overwrite a verified record with an unverified import without an explicit review event.
Generate relationships only when the source establishes the relationship or when the relationship is explicitly marked analytical.
next_operations: Expand every Family Code hierarchy node to section-level records.
